svg.title: openchemlib-sqlite — the tables migrate() adds
svg.desc: Schema version 6: the fingerprint index, the two structure-hash tables, the plane index with its watermark, and the bookkeeping tables, alongside the entries table the caller owns.
svg.text: Schema version 6. Every entry_id refers to your entries table; the plane index stays empty until foldPlanes() runs.
